parties.respondent: The State of Uttarakhand and Others

summary: 18 months D.El.Ed. diploma via ODL from NIOS; validity for appointment; one-time scheme under RTE Act, 2009 s.23(2); limited to in-service teachers as on 10.08.2017; clarification of 10.12.2024 applied; eligibility for state vacancies; selection process not to be reopened; appointment directed within three months if eligible.
legal_provisions_cited: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 s.23
Uttarakhand Government Elementary Education (Teacher) Service Rules, 2012
final_judgment: State directed to consider applicants' claims within three months; appointment to be made if eligible; selection process already completed not to be reopened; petitions disposed of.
